positive.prompt: Keep implementation notes while you build this
Log your deviations from the spec as you go
Start a decision log for this build

negative.prompt: Write an ADR for choosing Postgres
Write a failing test for this bug

evals.prompt: Implement task 2 from tasks/plan.md and keep implementation notes.
expectations: tasks/impl-notes.md is created before the first code change
Unplanned decisions are logged with file:line
Deviations take the conservative option and are logged rather than silently improvised
Irreversible or Ask-first items are escalated, not logged as deviations
